name: Ars Amatoria
source:
Daisuke walks along the streets of Tokyo. The night is full of love. Which girl will attract his attention next?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Daisuke漫步在东京的街头。夜色中弥漫着爱意。接下来，又会有哪位女孩吸引他的目光？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
